name: Survival — "if this creature is tapped" is read at fire time: Reluctant Role Model, Kona, Howling Mine, Mana Vault
notes: The site's fire-time check (_evaluateTriggerCondition in cards-text-utils.js) did not read "if this creature / this artifact / <card name> is tapped / untapped", so it returned null and the trigger always fired. It now reads the card's own Tap toggle (state.tapped or the 'Tapped' trait) and Attacking toggle, for a subject that is the card itself only (never "enchanted creature is untapped", Narcolepsy). Reluctant Role Model A is tapped and B untapped; Kona, Rescue Beastie ("if Kona is tapped", its short name) is tapped; Howling Mine ("if this artifact is untapped") is untapped; Mana Vault ("if this artifact is tapped") is untapped. Memory: project_trigger_condition_source_tapped_2026-10-15.
